inheritance: not used: every physical occurrence is materialized and is its own representative

status_semantics.not-required: format/provenance excludes the occurrence from native RISC-V semantic scanning
status_semantics.partial: candidate semantics, boundary, resolution, consumer, link, or runtime closure remains unresolved
status_semantics.pass-hit: candidate discovery complete; semantic interpretation may remain elsewhere
status_semantics.pass-no-hit: complete for the stated primitive/domain only; never a global no-ID claim
